title: Software Architect - Productionize AI Automation Platform
description:
About Us

We're building an AI-operated company. A 3-person CPG brand sold through major US retailers, where AI agents handle the work that would normally require a team of 15+: content creation, social media, customer outreach, product discovery, financial modeling, and autonomous pipeline monitoring.

Over the past 6+ months, our CEO built 9+ AI automation systems using AI coding tools (Claude Code). We already have an autonomous AI agent that runs 24/7, delivering morning briefs, monitoring all pipelines, and alerting via Slack on a 2-hour heartbeat. The vision is to deploy autonomous agents across every function of the business.

The systems work and deliver real operational leverage. But they were built through rapid experimentation and need production-grade architecture to support the next wave: more agents, more autonomy, more reliability.

This engagement was scoped by a Fortune 50 AI & technology executive who will oversee the build and review all deliverables. We're looking for top candidates who can defend their architectural decisions to senior technical leadership.

What Exists Today

- 9+ production automation systems (100+ Python scripts) running on a Mac Mini M4
- 20+ daily cron jobs across content, social, monitoring, and reporting
- Integrations with: Google Sheets, Slack, Meta Graph API, TikTok, multiple retail APIs
- Engineering practices: deployment scripts, post-deploy verification, health monitoring, AI-assisted code review
- An autonomous AI agent (24/7) delivering briefs, monitoring pipelines, alerting via Slack
- Multiple systems making LLM calls (Claude, GPT) for content generation, scoring, and decision-making
- Knowledge base: 100+ documented lessons from production incidents

What's Missing

- No version control (no git)
- No CI/CD (manual SCP-based deployment)
- Flat directory structure (no packages or modules)
- Systems operate in silos (don't coordinate with each other)
- Google Sheets as primary data store
- Only the CEO can operate, debug, or deploy (bus factor of 1)
- API keys hardcoded in scripts
- Scripts fail silently with no alerting
- No standardized patterns for AI agent deployment or LLM integration
- No framework for scaling from 1 autonomous agent to many

What We Need You to Build

Phase 1 - Automation Audit & Mapping
- Inventory all automations, map dependencies between systems
- Define core data objects and integration points
- Produce a technical blueprint the non-technical team can read

Phase 2 - System Architecture Design
- AI agent infrastructure: patterns for deploying, monitoring, and coordinating autonomous agents across business functions
- LLM integration layer: standardized patterns for AI calls, prompt management, cost tracking, output validation, and retry logic
- Design workflow orchestration supporting both fully autonomous and human-in-the-loop operations
- Design shared modules (Sheets, Slack, scraping, etc.) so new tools reuse existing work
- Integration layer so systems coordinate instead of operating in silos
- Deployment and rollback that a non-engineer can execute
- Data layer strategy (reduce Google Sheets dependency, define where operational state lives)
- Guardrails: auth, cost limits, approval gates

Phase 3 - Workflow Refactoring
- Modularize scripts into packages
- Add retry/failure handling
- Create reusable components
- Enforce shared schemas across systems

Phase 4 - Observability & Cost Controls
- Structured logging
- One-place visibility into what ran, what succeeded, what failed
- Dead-pipeline detection and alerting
- Cost tracking for API usage

Critical Constraints (read carefully)

1. The team is non-technical. The CEO builds with AI coding tools. The cofounder and ops specialist are not engineers. Everything you build must be operable by non-engineers with AI assistance. If your architecture requires an engineer to maintain it, you've failed.

2. AI-assisted development continues. The CEO uses AI coding tools (Claude Code) as his primary development tool. This will continue after your engagement. Your architecture must create patterns that make AI-assisted development faster and more reliable, not harder. Think: clear module boundaries, consistent naming, documented interfaces.

3. The codebase is Python. It stays Python. Don't propose a rewrite in another language.

4. Infrastructure migration is expected. The current production environment is a Mac Mini M4 on a home network, primarily hosting an autonomous AI agent. We want to reduce dependence on this setup. Your architecture should include a migration path to sustainable, cloud-friendly infrastructure.

5. The platform must stand on its own. An outside engineering team should be able to evaluate, understand, and operate it without the founder. Your deliverable should include a technical narrative documenting the full architecture.

6. Don't over-engineer. We are 3 people, not 300. If you're thinking Kubernetes, microservices, or infrastructure-as-code, this isn't the right engagement. We need organized, documented, observable Python with clean deployment. That's it.

Ideal Candidate

- 7+ years Python in production
- Has architected systems for small teams or startups (not just enterprise)
- Can design for a team scaling from 3 to 5 (we plan to hire an engineer after this engagement)
- Has built systems that non-engineers operate day-to-day
- Experience designing systems where AI agents operate autonomously (not just AI-assisted tools)
- Understanding of LLM integration patterns: prompt management, cost controls, output validation
- Comfortable with AI-assisted development (the CEO builds with Claude Code daily)
- Strong written communication. You'll produce documentation a business operator reads, not just code
- Bonus: experience with automation/workflow orchestration (cron-based, event-driven)

How We'll Work

- Phase 1 is a paid trial. You'll audit the codebase, produce a blueprint, and we'll evaluate fit.
- If Phase 1 goes well, we proceed to Phases 2-4 on an hourly basis.
- Communication via Slack. Daily check-ins with the CEO (hands-on founder).
- Full codebase access from day one.
- We'll share our existing productionization plan as your starting framework.
- Final deliverable includes a technical narrative documenting the full architecture, suitable for review by outside engineering leadership.

To Apply

Skip the generic cover letter. Instead, answer these three questions:

1. What would you specifically NOT build for a 3-person non-technical team running Python automations on a Mac Mini?
2. Describe a time you architected a system that a non-engineer operates day-to-day. What made it work?
3. What's your honest reaction to a codebase of 100+ Python scripts in a flat directory with no git? What's your first move?

A conversational AI query engine — CLI only, no GUI, no web interface. Think ELIZA with memory context

It routes the query to Claude (default) or Mistral (EU sovereign tier), manages session context across turns, and

Stay focused on the engine.

Python 3.11+ or Go — production quality, not tutorial quality

decisions

What This Is Not

We are building a production API integration and CLI engine. The work is programming, not configuration.

library v1, and a working proof-of-concept CLI stub that connects to both APIs and returns a response. This is

title: Full-Stack SaaS Developer — Swiss ESG Compliance Platform for SMEs (MVP to Full Product)
description:
Full-Stack SaaS Developer — Swiss ESG Compliance Platform for SMEs (MVP to Full Product)

Project Overview:
I am building a Swiss-hosted ESG compliance SaaS platform for Swiss SMEs (5–50 employees) and fiduciaries (Treuhänder) who manage multiple client mandates. The platform helps Swiss SMEs document ESG reporting, LkSG/VSoTr supply chain compliance, and sustainability requirements from banks and large customers.
This is a multi-tenant B2B SaaS application. Think of it as a compliance management tool where one fiduciary manages 10–30 SME clients from a single dashboard.
Inspiration/Reference products: ZEROvia (zerovia.ch), Plan A, Normative — but focused exclusively on the Swiss fiduciary channel and LkSG compliance, which none of these cover adequately.

Tech Stack (required):

Frontend: React or Vue.js
Backend: Node.js (Express) or Laravel (PHP)
Database: PostgreSQL
Hosting: Infomaniak (Switzerland) — mandatory for Swiss data protection law (nDSG)
Authentication: Auth0 or Supabase Auth
PDF Generation: Puppeteer or PDFKit or WeasyPrint
Email/Notifications: Postmark or Mailgun
File Storage: Infomaniak Swiss Object Storage (S3-compatible)
AI Integration: Anthropic Claude API (claude-sonnet) for document extraction
XBRL Export: EFRAG Digital Template format (same standard as ZEROvia)
Payments: Stripe (CHF currency)
Background Jobs: Bull (Node) or Laravel Queues for automated reminders and annual reports


Features Required:
Module 1 — ESG Core (MVP — build first)

Guided VSME Basic + Comprehensive data entry form (step by step, one question at a time)
Help text on every field explaining where to find the data
CSV upload for bulk data entry
Automatic PDF report generation (VSME format, OR 964j format)
XBRL export (EFRAG Digital Template — same as CSRD-standard)
Gap indicator — traffic light system showing missing mandatory fields
ESG Score 0–100 with breakdown by E, S, G dimensions
Year-on-year progress comparison

Module 2 — Supply Chain

Curated database of 50+ large Swiss companies (Migros, SBB, Coop, Nestlé etc.) and their specific ESG requirements
Side-by-side requirement comparison tool
«Does my ESG report cover what this customer needs?» checker

Module 3 — Retention & Task Management

Task management system with assignable deadlines
Automatic email reminders before deadlines
Automatic annual report generation trigger (January each year)
Progress dashboard per mandate

Module 4 — LkSG/VSoTr Compliance (MVP — build first)

Guided due diligence questionnaire (German Supply Chain Act)
Documentation PDF generator — audit-ready output
VSoTr (Swiss supply chain ordinance) compliance check
Complaint mechanism documentation template
Risk country flagging for supplier countries

Module 5 — Banking Export

Formatted ESG report export specifically for Swiss banks
ZKB format compatibility
Raiffeisen format compatibility
«Bank-ready» one-click export

Module 6 — Visibility & Benchmarking

Public sustainability profile page at yourplatform.ch/company-name
Shareable link replacing PDF email attachments
Anonymous peer benchmarking by industry (NACE code — same methodology as ZEROvia, active after 100+ customers)
Internal fiduciary leaderboard showing ESG scores across all mandates
AI-assisted data entry: user uploads existing documents (annual report, invoices), Claude API extracts relevant ESG values, human confirms before saving

Module 7 — EU Ecodesign Product Pass

Digital product pass generator (EU Ecodesign Regulation 2024/1781)
Auto-generation from existing ESG data already in the system — zero double entry
QR code output linking to machine-readable product data
PDF version for attaching to delivery documents
Fields: CO₂ per unit, materials with origin, repairability index, recycled content percentage

Module 8 — Materiality Analysis

Double materiality questionnaire (25–30 guided questions, CSRD/ESRS standard)
Two dimensions scored: impact materiality (outside-in) + financial materiality (inside-out)
Automatic materiality matrix visualization
PDF export — audit-ready documentation
Integration with Module 1: after analysis, gap indicator only flags truly material fields as mandatory


Multi-Tenant Architecture (critical requirement):
This is the most important technical requirement. The system has two user roles:
Fiduciary role: Sees all their client mandates in one dashboard. Can switch between clients. Can compare clients. Manages deadlines across all mandates. White-label option (their own logo on client-facing reports).
SME role: Sees only their own company data. Fills in their ESG report. Downloads their documents.
Reference architecture: similar to how accounting software like Bexio handles multi-client fiduciary access.

General Technical Requirements:

Multi-tenant with full data isolation between tenants
Swiss data hosting mandatory (Infomaniak) — nDSG (Swiss GDPR equivalent) compliant
ISO 27001 compatible data handling
Mobile responsive (fiduciaries often work on tablets)
Secure login with 2FA option
Audit logs for all data changes
White-label PDF reports for fiduciary branding
GDPR + nDSG compliant data deletion and export


Regulatory Standards the platform must support:

VSME Basic and Comprehensive (EFRAG standard for SMEs)
Swiss OR 964j (Swiss Code of Obligations sustainability reporting)
LkSG (German Supply Chain Due Diligence Act)
VSoTr (Swiss Supply Chain Ordinance)
EU Ecodesign Regulation 2024/1781
CSRD Double Materiality (ESRS standard — for Module 8)
GHG Protocol (Scope 1, 2, 3 emissions calculation)


What I need from you:

Fixed price offer broken into milestones (Module 1+4 MVP first, then phases)
Realistic timeline estimate per phase
2–3 examples of previous SaaS platforms you have built with login, multi-tenant, PDF export
Your recommended tech stack with reasoning
Your experience with Swiss hosting (Infomaniak) or willingness to deploy there
Your availability per week in hours

Budget:
Open to phased approach. Please provide two numbers: full project estimate and MVP-only estimate (Module 1 + Module 4). I am building phase by phase as revenue comes in.
I am open to a phased development approach — starting with Module 1 and Module 4 as MVP, then expanding phase by phase as revenue comes in.

We are not looking for a freelancer to complete tasks.

automated, highest-quality B2B outbound agency in the world.

- Client intake and objective definition

- Data scraping and enrichment
- Campaign preparation and personalization at scale
- A/B testing and performance optimization

need step-by-step instructions to do your job, this is not the right 
role for you.

You are not a developer who learned automation on the side.
You are an automation operator who thinks in systems, speaks fluent

can be eliminated.

- Claude Code (this is our priority tool - you need to be advanced)

We read every application that includes a video. We respond fast

I am looking for an experienced developer to build an automated system that can generate business leads from Google search results, extract email addresses from websites, generate personalized outreach emails using AI, and send those emails automatically.

The system should run as an automated workflow and store results in Google Sheets for tracking.

10. **Daily Limit Control**

* Stop sending emails when the daily limit is reached

11. **Summary Report**

* Generate a daily summary report

title: AI-Powered Social Media Agency Platform — Full-Stack Build
description:
Project Overview
I am building a SaaS (Software as a Service) web platform that acts as a fully automated AI-powered digital marketing agency. My customers are business owners in Saudi Arabia and the Gulf region who need professional social media management and paid advertising — but cannot afford a traditional agency or in-house marketing team.
Instead of hiring human marketers, designers, and ad managers, I have built a system where AI agents do 100% of the work automatically. The business owner signs up, describes their business once, and the AI handles everything from that moment forward.
The core concept in one sentence: Customer pays a monthly subscription → AI writes their ads, generates images, creates video scripts, sets up paid campaigns on Snapchat / TikTok / Instagram / X, publishes content on a schedule, and sends weekly performance reports — fully automated, zero human staff on my side.
Reference: The closest existing example is ocoda.com — a Saudi digital marketing agency offering social media management, ad campaigns, graphic design, and performance reports delivered by a human team. My platform delivers the exact same services, but replaces the entire human team with AI agents running 24/7.

What You Are Being Hired to Build

Project type: Full-stack SaaS web application with an AI agent backend
Infrastructure: Self-hosted on 4 Apple Mac Minis (M2 Pro or M4, 32GB RAM each) at my office — no cloud servers
Target market: SMEs, e-commerce brands, restaurants, and retail businesses in Saudi Arabia and GCC
Languages: Arabic (RTL) and English — full bilingual support is mandatory throughout
Platforms served: Snapchat, TikTok, Instagram, X (Twitter)
Business model: Monthly subscriptions via Stripe (3 tiers)
Final deliverable: A complete, production-ready platform deployed and running on my 4 Mac Minis


How the Platform Works
The Customer Journey
Step 1 — Sign Up and Subscribe. The business owner visits the platform, creates an account, and selects a subscription plan. Payment is processed via Stripe and the account activates instantly.
Step 2 — Complete Brand Onboarding (one time only). The customer fills a smart onboarding form collecting: business name, industry, products or services, target audience, brand colors, preferred tone of voice, social media goals, which platforms they want, and their ad budget. This is saved permanently as their brand profile and feeds every AI agent from this point forward.
Step 3 — Request a Campaign. From their dashboard the customer clicks "New Campaign" and specifies what they want to promote, the goal (sales / awareness / followers), and the target dates. They click Submit. The job enters a queue.
Step 4 — AI Generates the Full Campaign (automatic). The AI pipeline runs on Mac Mini #2. In 5–15 minutes it produces: ad copy for all selected platforms, AI-generated branded images, a video script for TikTok and Snapchat, a paid ad campaign ready for approval, and a 30-day organic content calendar. The customer sees a live progress bar while this runs.
Step 5 — Customer Reviews and Approves. The customer opens their dashboard and sees a preview of every piece of content exactly as it will appear on each platform. For each item they can: Approve, Regenerate (AI creates a new version), or Skip. When satisfied they click Publish All.
Step 6 — AI Publishes and Manages Everything. The Scheduler Agent publishes organic posts at the optimal time per platform. The Browser Agent logs into Snapchat Ads Manager (and other ad platforms) using the customer's connected ad account and launches the paid campaign with the specified budget. The Reply Agent monitors comments and responds automatically.
Step 7 — Weekly Reports Delivered Automatically. Every Sunday the Analytics Agent pulls performance data from all platforms, writes a branded PDF report in Arabic and English, and emails it to the customer. The report covers reach, engagement, ad spend vs. conversions, best-performing content, and next week's recommendations.

The 9 AI Agents (What Runs on Mac Mini #2)
1. Research Agent — Searches the web for trends in the customer's niche, analyzes competitor accounts, and identifies viral content formats. Feeds insight to all other agents before they start. Tools: LangChain web tools, RAG pipeline, Qdrant vector search.
2. Copy Agent — Writes all ad copy: captions, hooks, headlines, CTAs. Platform-specific character limits. Arabic and English. Adapts tone to each brand's voice. Tools: Ollama running Llama 3.1 70B (local, no API cost), brand memory context.
3. Design Agent — Generates branded images, ad graphics, and story templates. Applies the customer's colors and logo. Auto-sizes for each platform's exact specification. Tools: FLUX or Stable Diffusion (local), Pillow, ImageMagick.
4. Script Agent — Creates complete TikTok and Snapchat video scripts: hook (0–3 seconds), main message, on-screen text, voice-over narration, and closing CTA. Tools: Llama 3.1, TikTok trend data, script templates.
5. Browser Agent — The most critical agent. Uses browser automation to log into Snapchat Ads Manager, TikTok Ads, Meta Ads, and X Ads exactly like a human media buyer would. Sets audience targeting, uploads creatives, sets budget, and launches the campaign. Tools: Playwright browser automation, platform APIs.
6. Scheduler Agent — Builds the 30-day content calendar. Publishes organic posts at the optimal time per platform algorithm. Manages the full publishing queue across all customers. Tools: Platform publishing APIs, BullMQ job queue, Redis.
7. Analytics Agent — Pulls performance data from all platforms weekly. Writes a plain-language Arabic/English report. Generates a branded PDF. Emails it to the customer automatically every Sunday. Tools: Platform analytics APIs, PDF generator, Resend email API.
8. Reply Agent — Monitors all comments on published posts. Responds 24/7 with brand-appropriate replies. Answers FAQs. Escalates complaints to the customer via email. Tools: Platform comment APIs, sentiment analysis, brand voice rules.
9. Brand Memory Agent — Stores each customer's complete brand profile as vector embeddings. Every other agent reads from this memory before generating anything, ensuring perfect brand consistency across all content forever. Tools: Qdrant vector database, LangChain RAG, PostgreSQL.

What the AI Delivers Per Platform
Snapchat: Vertical video script (9:16), Story Ads (3–5 frame sequence with AI images and overlay text), audience targeting setup, full paid campaign created inside Snapchat Ads Manager via browser automation, budget management, weekly performance pull.
TikTok: Full video script with hook (0–3 sec), on-screen text, voice-over narration, and CTA. AI-generated thumbnail. Trending hashtag research. TikTok In-Feed Ad campaign setup via TikTok Marketing API. Auto-published to customer's TikTok account.
Instagram: Feed post images at 1:1 and 4:5 with captions and hashtags. Reels script with cover image. Story design (9:16). Meta Ads campaign created via Meta Marketing API. Auto-published via Meta Graph API at optimal posting times.
X (Twitter): Tweet thread (opening tweet + 3–5 follow-ups). Single promo tweet with AI-generated banner image (2:1). Trending hashtags. X Ads Promoted Tweet campaign. Auto-posted via X API v2. Reply Agent monitors mentions.

Infrastructure: The 4 Mac Minis
All hardware is already owned and located at my office. You are deploying software to these machines, not setting up cloud servers.
Hardware per unit: Apple Mac Mini M2 Pro or M4 — 32GB Unified Memory — 1TB SSD — wired Ethernet. All 4 machines on the same local network with static private IPs. Public access via Cloudflare Tunnel on Mac Mini #1 (maps the domain to the local machine, no IP exposure). All services run in Docker containers managed via Portainer.
Mac Mini #1 — Gateway (Web Server + Customer Portal). Runs the customer-facing website and dashboard. Software: Next.js 14, Caddy web server (auto HTTPS), Cloudflare Tunnel, Stripe billing, Socket.io for real-time progress updates.
Mac Mini #2 — AI Engine (All 9 Agents). Dedicated 100% to AI workloads. Nothing else runs here. Software: Ollama (Llama 3.1 70B + Mistral), Stable Diffusion via AUTOMATIC1111 or ComfyUI with FLUX, CrewAI orchestration framework, Playwright browser automation, LangChain. Note: LLM alone uses 16GB RAM and image generation uses 8–12GB. 32GB is the minimum — this machine must not be shared with any other workload.
Mac Mini #3 — Data Hub (Database + Storage + Queue). All persistent data. No AI runs here. Software: PostgreSQL (main database), Qdrant (vector database for brand memory), MinIO (S3-compatible media storage with 3 buckets: brand-assets, generated-content, campaign-exports), Redis + BullMQ (job queue), automated nightly backups.
Mac Mini #4 — Control Room (Publishing, Auth, Monitoring). Handles all social media API publishing, authentication, monitoring, and email. Software: TikTok API, Meta Graph API, X API v2, Snapchat Marketing API — all OAuth 2.0. Supabase Auth, Grafana + Prometheus, Resend email, Portainer.

Full Technology Stack
Frontend: Next.js 14 with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, full Arabic RTL and English LTR support. Web server: Caddy with automatic HTTPS. Public access: Cloudflare Tunnel. Authentication: Supabase Auth. Payments: Stripe with SAR currency and webhook integration. Real-time UI: Socket.io for live campaign progress.
LLM: Ollama running Llama 3.1 70B and Mistral locally — zero external API cost, mandatory. Image generation: Stable Diffusion via AUTOMATIC1111 or ComfyUI with FLUX.1 — local, zero cost, mandatory. Agent orchestration: CrewAI (Python). Browser automation: Playwright (Python). RAG and memory: LangChain + Qdrant.
Database: PostgreSQL. Cache and queue: Redis + BullMQ. Media storage: MinIO. Monitoring: Grafana + Prometheus. Containers: Docker + Docker Compose + Portainer. Email: Resend API. PDF reports: WeasyPrint or ReportLab.
Social APIs: Snapchat Marketing API v1, TikTok for Developers API (Content Posting + Ads), Meta Graph API, X API v2 Basic tier (paid by me at $100/month).

Required Screens and Features
Public website: Landing page with hero, benefits, pricing, testimonials, and FAQ. Pricing page with 3-plan comparison table. Sign up, login, and password reset pages. Arabic/English language toggle with full RTL/LTR switching.
Customer dashboard: Overview showing active campaigns, recent posts, subscription status, and quick stats. Brand Profile page to view and edit onboarding data and reconnect social accounts. New Campaign form with platform selector, goal, description, budget, and dates. Campaign Progress screen with real-time agent status bar. Campaign Preview with mobile-frame previews per platform and Approve / Regenerate / Skip buttons. Campaign history with status and performance snapshot. Analytics dashboard with charts for reach, engagement, follower growth, and ad spend vs. conversions. Reports tab with downloadable weekly PDFs. Connected Accounts screen with OAuth buttons for all 4 platforms. Billing page with current plan, upgrade/downgrade, and invoice history.
Owner admin panel: Customer list with subscription tier and status. Revenue dashboard showing MRR, churn, and new signups. Live campaign queue monitor. System health view with Grafana embedded. AI quality review tool for sampling recent outputs. Manual override to pause, cancel, or re-run any job.

Project Deliverables by Phase
Phase 1 — Infrastructure (Weeks 1–2): Docker and Docker Compose on all 4 Mac Minis. Static IP and LAN networking between machines. Cloudflare Tunnel on Mac Mini #1. Portainer deployed on Mac Mini #4. Grafana + Prometheus connected to all machines.
Phase 2 — AI Backend (Weeks 3–5): Ollama with Llama 3.1 70B and Mistral installed and tested. Stable Diffusion (AUTOMATIC1111 or ComfyUI + FLUX) installed and tested. All 9 AI agents built in CrewAI with correct roles and tool access. Full pipeline tested end-to-end with 3 sample businesses. Playwright Browser Agent tested against Snapchat Ads Manager. BullMQ queue connected: submission → queue → Mac Mini #2 processes → result stored.
Phase 3 — Database and Storage (Week 6): PostgreSQL with full schema (customers, brands, campaigns, posts, analytics, subscriptions). Qdrant connected to Brand Memory Agent. MinIO with 3 buckets. Automated nightly backups.
Phase 4 — Customer Platform (Weeks 7–9): Complete Next.js app with all screens listed above. Full Arabic RTL and English LTR. Stripe subscription integration with billing portal and webhooks. Supabase Auth. Real-time progress bar via Socket.io. Campaign preview with mobile-frame rendering. Analytics charts. PDF report download. OAuth connected accounts screen.
Phase 5 — Social Media APIs (Weeks 10–11): All 4 platform OAuth flows. Organic post publishing on all platforms. Paid ad campaign creation on Snapchat, TikTok, Meta, and X. Analytics pull jobs running every 24 hours. Weekly report generation every Sunday with Arabic/English PDF sent via Resend.
Phase 6 — Testing and Launch (Week 12): End-to-end test with 5 real beta accounts covering the full flow. Load test simulating 20 simultaneous campaign requests. All API integrations verified with real accounts. Admin panel live with real data. Complete technical documentation including architecture diagram, setup guide, and API credentials guide. Handover call walking me through the full system.

Required Skills
Must-have: Full-stack web development with Next.js/React (TypeScript) and PostgreSQL. Python backend development with async programming. AI/LLM integration experience with Ollama or similar local model deployment. Agent framework experience with CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen, or equivalent. Docker deployments on Apple Silicon (ARM64). OAuth 2.0 API integration. Arabic RTL web development. Stripe subscription billing.
Highly preferred: Playwright or Selenium browser automation. Stable Diffusion or FLUX image generation deployment. Experience with at least one social media API (Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, or X). Redis and BullMQ job queues. Qdrant or Pinecone vector databases. Grafana + Prometheus setup. MinIO or S3 storage integration.
In your proposal please include: A description and link/screenshot of the most similar project you have built. Which parts of this stack you have direct experience with. Whether you will work alone or with a team. A timeline estimate broken down by the 6 phases above. Your fixed price or hourly rate with a total project estimate. Any questions or concerns about the technical requirements.

Important Notes
All AI must run locally. This is non-negotiable. All text generation (Llama 3.1 via Ollama) and all image generation (Stable Diffusion / FLUX) must run on Mac Mini #2. There must be zero calls to OpenAI, Anthropic, Midjourney, or any paid AI API. The entire business model depends on this cost structure.
Ad account ownership. Customers connect their own Snapchat Business, Meta, TikTok, and X ad accounts via OAuth. The platform does not hold customer ad budgets. When the Browser Agent creates a campaign it is created inside the customer's own ad account, charged to their own payment method. The platform automates the setup only.
Arabic is a first-class requirement. Full RTL layout throughout the customer-facing app. AI agents must generate content in Arabic when the customer's language is set to Arabic. Weekly PDF reports must be fully readable in Arabic. This is not a cosmetic feature — it is core to the product.
Apply for the TikTok API in Week 1. TikTok for Developers API approval takes 1–3 weeks. The application must be submitted at the very start of the project, not at the integration phase. I will provide all required business details immediately.
What I provide: 4 Mac Minis (hardware already owned). Domain name and Cloudflare account. Stripe, Snapchat Business, Meta Business, TikTok Business, and X Developer accounts. X API Basic tier ($100/month, paid by me). Platform name, logo, and brand colors (provided at project start).
Code quality. All code must be clean, well-commented, and logically structured. A README for each major component is required. An architecture diagram showing all 4 Mac Minis, their services, and communication flows must be included in the final handover.

title: AI Automation Specialist (Make, Zapier, Go High Level, AI Agents, Assistable)
description:
Company: Spot Digital Marketing
Location: Remote
Project Type: Ongoing / Part-Time

About Us

Spot Digital Marketing is a digital marketing agency working primarily with health, wellness, med spa, peptide, and ecommerce brands.

We are actively integrating AI tools and automation systems into both our internal operations and our client marketing systems. We are looking for an AI Automation Specialist who can help us build and maintain these systems.

This role focuses on implementing AI agents, building automation workflows, and integrating tools across multiple platforms.

What You'll Be Doing
AI Agent Setup

• Install and configure AI Voice agents and AI Chatbots
• Implement AI agents using Assistable.ai or similar platforms
• Install AI chat and voice systems inside Go High Level and client websites
• Test AI agents to ensure they respond correctly and perform well
• Make improvements and adjustments over time

Automation Development

• Build automation workflows using Make (Integromat), Zapier, or similar platforms
• Connect systems such as Go High Level, ClickUp, Slack, Google Sheets, and CRMs
• Create automations that move data between platforms
• Automate repetitive tasks across marketing, reporting, and internal operations

Example automations may include:

• Lead routing and notifications
• Automated task creation
• AI-generated summaries or responses
• Client reporting workflows

AI Workflow Optimization

• Use ChatGPT or other AI tools inside automation workflows
• Improve prompts and AI outputs
• Test and optimize automation performance
• Identify opportunities to automate additional processes

System Maintenance

• Monitor automations and ensure they run properly
• Troubleshoot broken workflows
• Update automations as systems evolve
• Maintain existing automations for both our agency and clients

Required Experience

• Experience building automations using Make, Zapier, or similar tools
• Experience integrating tools like Go High Level, ClickUp, Slack, Google Sheets, or CRMs
• Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or OpenAI in workflows
• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving ability
• Ability to build and maintain automation systems independently

Nice to Have

• Experience working with Assistable.ai or similar AI agent platforms
• Experience installing AI Voice agents or AI chatbots
• Experience working with webhooks and APIs
• Experience working with marketing agencies or marketing tools

Application Instructions

To be considered, please include the following:

Examples of automations you have built (brief description is fine)

The automation tools you use most often (Make, Zapier, n8n, etc.)

A short 2–3 minute video explaining why you would be a good fit for this role

Confirmation if you have worked with Go High Level or AI agent platforms

Please begin your application with the word “Automation” so we know you read the full post.

Quick Technical Question

Please briefly explain how you would build the following automation:

A new lead fills out a website form →
The lead is added to Go High Level →
A task is created in ClickUp →
A Slack notification is sent to the team →
ChatGPT generates a short AI summary of the lead for the team

You do not need to build this. Just explain how you would structure the workflow.

Additional Info

This will begin as a part-time role with the potential to grow into a larger ongoing position as we expand our automation systems.

Final candidates may be asked to complete a small paid test project to demonstrate their skills.
